role: Displays filtered system logs with real-time telemetry in a scrollable panel
detail: React FC that renders a scrollable log viewer with toggle filters (all/warn+/error). Pulls systemLogs from useAppStore and filters by level. Displays entries with HH:MM:SS timestamp (sliced from ISO string at chars 11-19) and colored text per level (info=#81C784, warn=#FFB74D, error=#EF5350). Uses useAutoScroll hook to auto-scroll on new entries. Shows count badge (current/max) and empty state ('Waiting for telemetry...' or 'No entries match filter'). Fixed max retention of 200 entries (MAX_ENTRIES constant, matches store slice cap). Hover effect adds subtle bg highlight. Monospace JetBrains/Fira font, dark theme (#0d1117 bg). No network/DB writes; read-only consumer of store state.
gotchas: Entry key uses array index (i) instead of stable ID — reorders/duplicates could cause React keying issues if log entries are modified in-place
